reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I video journal all the time. This app felt like a great vault for this, so I paid for a full year which was not cheap. I looked past little bugs I encountered along the way, When I went back months later to reflect on past recordings, almost all of my videos wouldn’t play, and I couldn’t download them. I was able to connect with support, but they went quiet after saying they’d look into the issue I hope access gets restored so I can look back at these journal entries and continue using the app. Until then, I can’t give a positive review.

reviews.title: App
reviews.text:
I actually really like this app; it's pretty cool and amazing. Overall, I definitely like it and think the video feature should be kept, but there are a few things that could be improved:

1. Performance: Sometimes when I go back in and click on my diary entry for a video I already filmed, it freezes up. That definitely needs an update.
2. Pricing: The subscription plans shouldn't force a weekly charge or a high upfront annual cost. It would be much better to offer a monthly premium option around $5 to $10 (or maybe $6). Truth be told, in this economy people don't have the money to constantly pay high amounts for apps when monthly bills are due.
3. Video features: We should have the option to make videos bigger, save them directly to our phones, and easily post or upload them.
4. Security: The password or Face ID options should be flexible so we can easily switch or change between them.
5. Customization: It would be great to have more customization to make the app even cooler, like being able to change the app icon and choose different themes to make it 
aesthetic, cute, and pretty.

reviews.title: Journaling upleveled
reviews.text: I am someone who has always been intimidated by physical writing in a journal every day. This is a service where it’s easy to grab your phone and express your thoughts in a video journal in real time. And the extra bonus of the AI analyzing for you and giving you a summary the next day is something I would never do on my own with a physical journal. It’s a great adjunct to Therapy, not a replacement but a great place to organize your thoughts that you might bring to a real person therapist.
